name: falcon_lending_bot_overview
title: Read the Solana lending bot overview
description: Read retained customer-owned Solana mainnet-beta lending bot state. This does not capture provider data, start work, sign, send, or establish funded readiness. NEAR CFO and legacy Solana Devnet remain separate workflows.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session. Treat it as a short-lived password; never repeat it in prose.

name: falcon_lending_bot_capture
title: Capture current Solana lending observations
description: Request an explicit real read of the authenticated customer's supported Solana mainnet-beta lending portfolio. Missing evidence stays unavailable; capture does not start the bot or prove executable liquidity or readiness.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session; never repeat it in prose.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID request identity; reuse exactly for a retry.

name: falcon_lending_bot_start
title: Start the customer-approved Solana lending bot
description: Request bot start for the authenticated customer. Mesh must recheck an existing human-approved mandate and actual installed customer-owned policy-limited delegation; this tool only activates that existing authority. MCP has no wallet/delegation installation, signing, or direct-send tool and cannot widen the installed policy.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session; never repeat it in prose.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID request identity; reuse exactly for a retry.

name: falcon_lending_bot_pause
title: Pause the customer-owned Solana lending bot
description: Commit a stop for new bot signing or sending. Already-submitted actions remain reconcilable; this does not revoke a wallet signer or undo a transaction.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session; never repeat it in prose.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID request identity; reuse exactly for a retry.

name: falcon_lending_bot_withdraw
title: Prepare an unsigned owner-approved withdrawal
description: Prepare one exact unsigned Solana mainnet-beta withdrawal from a supported reserve for owner review. The returned prepared transaction is unsigned; MCP does not sign or broadcast it. The authenticated session supplies the owner and wallet. Mesh enforces supported reserve, current portfolio and policy limits; unpaid fees cannot block exit.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session; never repeat it in prose.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID request identity; reuse exactly for a retry.

reserveAddress.description: Solana reserve account address; Mesh accepts only its fixed reviewed reserve set.

receiptBaseUnits.description: Positive canonical integer receipt-token base units, never a floating-point value.

name: falcon_lending_bot_reconcile
title: Reconcile a Solana lending bot action
description: Read current finalized receipt evidence for one owner-bound action. Missing or incomplete proof stays unknown; reconciliation never creates a replacement signature or submits another spend.

session.description: Existing Falcon wallet session; never repeat it in prose.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied UUID request identity; reuse exactly for a retry.

actionId.description: Owner-bound action identifier returned by Mesh.

name: falcon_lending_bot_fee_claim
title: Prepare an unsigned owner-approved fee claim
description: Prepare the exact unsigned fee transfer only from a reconciled positive amount owed, the trusted configured recipient, and observed available cash. The caller cannot supply an amount or recipient. MCP does not sign or broadcast; the owner reviews and separately signs the exact transfer.
